description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalupedigama, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620006
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and land characteristics. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
